_readme: Curated registry of on-chain services whose involvement is a risk SIGNAL.
Interaction with a mixer is not a crime and not evidence of one. People use
privacy tools for private reasons. Umbra records the touch and its
provenance; a human decides what it means.
Every entry must carry `verification`. An address labelled 'mixer' that is
not one is a false accusation against whoever controls it, so nothing goes
in here on recollection alone. `code_sha256` is the keccak-free sha256 of
the deployed bytecode, read from a public node — three of the pools below
share byte-identical code, which is what a single contract deployed at
sanctions_status is deliberately NOT a field. OFAC listings change (Tornado
Cash: designated 2022-08-08, removed 2025) and the live SDN lake is the only
thing allowed to answer that question.
